Definition: from G3361 and the neuter of G5100; whether at all:--not (the particle usually not expressed, except by the form of the question).
BiblicalUsage: Paul asks whether he used lightness in his plans, and tells married couples not to defraud one another except for a time of prayer, lest Satan tempt them. The word is a little particle, usually left untranslated, that turns a sentence into a question expecting the answer no.
TheologicalSignificance: I notice how much work one small word does: it lets Paul question himself in public, and it lets him warn married couples that even prayer has its season, and the tempter waits for the gap.
